_about: Map colour steps, as fractions of all votes. Every place is coloured for whoever leads it: step 1 is a lead under thresholds[0], step i+1 a lead of at least thresholds[i]. Only an exact tie gets the neutral colour. Loaded by marginBins.ts; colours per step are in styles/tokens.css (--map-d1..6, --map-r1..6, --map-tie). labels has one entry per step.
